title: Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5843 with AT&T Enterprises LLC: To increase the contract authority by $1,011,900, for new total not to exceed $3,611,900, and extend the term by two (2)
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5843 with AT&T Enterprises LLC: To increase the contract authority by $1,011,900, for new total not to exceed $3,611,900, and extend the term by two (2) years, covering wireless voice, data, equipment, and related services for Los Angeles World Airports (Aura Moore)
